ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows a large dotted-line square region, with several small squares drawn in the lower left corner and filled with numbers. It can be seen that the lower left corner is 1, to its right is 2, above 1 is 3, above 3 is 4; farther down to the right appear 5, 6 in order; on the next diagonal in the opposite direction there are 7, 8, 9, 10. The small square in the upper right corner is labeled x. From these visible numbers it can be judged that the small squares are numbered in diagonal “zigzag” order. Reasoning: Suppose the large dotted-line square is an n×n grid array, the lower left corner is coordinate (1,1), and the square labeled x in the upper right corner is (n,n). The numbering proceeds along oblique diagonals, and the diagonal where (n,n) lies is the 2n-1-th one. Before it there are a total of 1+2+...+(2n-2) numbers. Since on this diagonal, (n,n) is the n-th position, x = 1+2+...+(2n-2)+n = (n-1)(2n-1)+n = 2n^2-2n+1. Therefore the possible values of x are 1, 5, 13, 25, 41, ..., always odd numbers. 128 is an even number and does not conform to this form, so x cannot be 128.

raw_record.question_text: You write a number in each square as shown in the square figure. Then, the number $x$ cannot be:

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: the small squares are filled in a diagonal zigzag order. The visible entries show 1 at the lower-left, then 2 to its right, 3 above 1, then 4 above 3, 5 diagonally down-right, 6 on the bottom row, then 7, 8, 9, 10 along the next opposite diagonal. Interpret the dashed large square as an n by n square, so the top-right square labeled x has coordinates (n,n). Count the numbers before the diagonal containing (n,n): that diagonal has index 2n-1, so before it there are 1+2+...+(2n-2) numbers. Since (n,n) is the nth entry on that diagonal, x = (1+2+...+(2n-2)) + n = (n-1)(2n-1)+n = 2n^2 - 2n + 1. Therefore possible x values are 1, 5, 13, 25, 41, ...; in particular x is always odd and of this centered-square form. Since 128 is even and not of this form, x cannot be 128.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个虚线大正方形区域，左下角画出了若干小方格并填有数字。可见左下角为 1，它右边是 2，1 的上方是 3，3 的上方是 4；再往右下方向依次出现 5、6；下一条反方向的斜线上有 7、8、9、10。右上角的小方格标着 x。由这些可见数字可判断，小方格按对角线“之”字形顺序编号。

推理：设虚线大正方形是 n×n 的方格阵，左下角为坐标 (1,1)，右上角标 x 的方格为 (n,n)。编号按斜对角线进行，(n,n) 所在的对角线是第 2n-1 条。在它之前共有 1+2+...+(2n-2) 个数。由于在这条对角线上，(n,n) 是第 n 个位置，所以
x = 1+2+...+(2n-2)+n
= (n-1)(2n-1)+n
= 2n^2-2n+1。
因此 x 的可能值为 1, 5, 13, 25, 41, ...，总是奇数。128 是偶数，不符合这个形式，所以 x 不能是 128。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the placement of the visible numbers 1 through 10 in the lower-left staircase and the position of x in the top-right square of the dashed large square.
